text:
Alex Chen: Quick q — I turned 50 this month, woo 🎉. How do I enable 401(k) catch-up contributions? Also I was auto-enrolled at 3% during onboarding. Can I opt out of auto-enroll and set up catch-up starting next pay? Payroll cutoff timing?

Maya Patel: Congrats @Alex! For catch-up you can add it in the ADP portal under Benefits > Retirement elections. Catch-up is an extra dollar amount on top of your regular deferral.

Sophie Li: Payroll note: changes submitted before payroll cutoff (Fri 11:59pm PT) get into the next pay run. After cutoff it won't take effect until the following pay period.

Alex Chen: Thanks. Is there a max for catch-up? And do I have to opt out of the auto-enroll first or will manually setting the deferral override it?

Maya Patel: IRS catch-up limit for 2025 is $7,500 (always check IRS for yearly updates). You don't need to opt out separately — if you manually set your deferral it overrides the auto-enroll amount. If you want the system to stop auto-enrolling you can also opt out but it's not required to add catch-up.

hr-bot: Reminder: catch-up contributions are employee pre-tax or Roth catch-up (if plan allows) and employers typically do NOT match catch-up amounts. See plan docs for matching rules.

Ben Ortiz: Heads up from finance: if your total deferral + catch-up would exceed per-pay-period withhold limits (esp on bonuses/supplemental pay), payroll may cap it and move excess to the next period or convert per IRS/plan rules. If that's a concern, tell us the target annual amount and payroll can spread it.

Sophie Li: If you'd like, DM me the employee ID and the effective pay date you'd like and I can submit the change on your behalf (saves you clicking around ADP).

Alex Chen: I'll DM you the ID. One more q — what's the ADP path exactly?

Maya Patel: ADP nav: Myself > Benefits > Retirement > Edit elections. If you run into the UI use this quick snippet:

```
ADP > Myself > Benefits > Retirement > Edit elections > Enter % or $ per paycheck > Save
```
Alex Chen: Perfect, sending DM now. Thanks y'all :thumbsup:

Sophie Li: Got it, I'll take care of it once I have the ID. (added reaction :white_check_mark:)
